reasoning: The question asks whether the Federal Reserve's interest rate on reserve balances (IORB) will increase between October 26, 2025 and November 2, 2025. This is a 7-day window. The IORB is set by the Board of Governors as a monetary policy tool and typically changes only during scheduled FOMC meetings or in response to major economic events. The next scheduled FOMC meeting after October 26 would likely be in mid-November (FOMC typically meets 8 times per year). Without a scheduled meeting in this narrow 7-day window, an increase is unlikely unless there's an emergency action. Historical precedent suggests emergency rate changes are rare. The probability of an unscheduled rate increase in this specific week is very low.
